technicalLines: 1x 8-pin RJ-45 female | Unidirectional to Network Switch | 1-way PoE (Switch powers device)
featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SYN-KEY10 is a simple single-room single gang RS-232 or IP control Keypad designed to be compatible with our Synergy presentation switchers and other 3 rd party devices, to help create a complete solution. Up to 10 customizable keys can be programmed for single-action or multiple-action macro on one button. Build a kit with the SYN-KEY-10 with any of our Synergy products as an all-in-one solution or as a standalone controller for 3 rd party devices.

The SYN-KEY10 provides a comprehensive solution for today's demanding corporate and education applications. Control all aspects of a room ranging from input switching, display power, lighting, shades/blinds, and even create macros which can trigger different scenes in one press.

No complicated wiring needed to get started with the SYN-KEY10! You’ll only need one cable to power and deliver commands over single-standard category cable. If no PoE is present in your installation. If no PoE is present in your installation, a 2-pin local power is available.

Included are 2 sheets of stickers to cover the SYN-KEY10's tactile buttons and with pleanty to choose from! They're strong enough to withstand multiple button touches, but easy to peel off for quick change-outs.
All your creative customization ideas are designed over an easy-to-use Webui. Edit and test commands & devices, create groups, and more with easy to understand menu options.
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
